mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO recording_checklist_results ( recording_session_id, checklist_item_id, status, confidence_score, evidence_text, reason ) VALUES ( #{recordingSessionId}, #{item.checklistItemId}, #{item.status}, #{item.confidenceScore}, #{item.evidenceText}, #{item.reason} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), confidence_score = VALUES(confidence_score), evidence_text = VALUES(evidence_text), reason = VALUES(reason), modified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT checklist_item_id AS checklistItemId, status, confidence_score AS confidenceScore, evidence_text AS evidenceText, reason FROM recording_checklist_results WHERE recording_session_id = #{recordingSessionId} ORDER BY checklist_item_id ASC
